title: StereoDroid: a phone in a Cardboard-style viewer as a VR headset for SteamVR on Linux
description: StereoDroid is a planned way to use an Android phone in a Cardboard-style viewer as a head-tracked VR headset for SteamVR on Linux, through ALVR and PhoneVR. Part of Sparky Stereo OS. This snapshot is the design; nothing is built yet. Licence: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL, the licence of KDE Connect for Android.
